Line one reads on the keyboard of #7 as eight characters, though not by taking the longest code each time. It is a saying from the 易經 about what two people of one mind can do.
Line two repeats characters of line one with fewer keys. Quick (速成) keeps only the first and last Cangjie letter of each character; the workbench reads it as zh_quick.
The couplet gave Chinese its word for sworn friendship, 金蘭. Two picks on Quick are deep, ranks 4 and 7 as the workbench numbers them, but both are inside the ten it lists by default.
